method: Entries added in v1.3.0.5 to widen the set of recognised paradigms. Each value was written from recall of the cited literature; no primary source was read, and none is tiered above the recall band.

meta:nudge_general_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Raw pooled d about 0.43 (Mertens et al. 2022) and a bias-corrected near-zero reading (Maier et al. 2022) are both recalled; the stored 0.15 is a deliberately small compromise between them, not a published number. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.
meta:nudge_general_meta.source: Mertens et al. (2022, PNAS); Maier et al. (2022, PNAS)

meta:social_norm_message_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Citation recognised; the size of the pooled effect is only loosely recalled (small, larger for intentions than behaviour). No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.
meta:social_norm_message_meta.source: Rhodes, Shulman & McClaran (2020, Human Communication Research)

meta:identifiable_victim_effect.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Lee & Feeley (2016) recalled as k=41 with a pooled r of about .05 (d about 0.10). No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.

meta:anthropomorphism_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Citation recognised as a service-robot / chatbot anthropomorphism meta-analysis; the magnitude is not judgeable from memory, so a small value with a wide interval is stored. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.
meta:anthropomorphism_meta.source: Blut, Wang, Wunderlich & Brock (2021, Journal of the Academy of Marketing Science)

meta:mortality_salience_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Original meta-analysis recalled as moderate; large preregistered replications recalled as near-null. 0.15 sits near the replication end; exact figures not recalled. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.
meta:mortality_salience_meta.source: Burke, Martens & Faucher (2010, Personality and Social Psychology Review); Klein et al. (2022, multi-site replication)

meta:source_credibility_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Citation recognised; a small-to-moderate source effect is recalled but the number is not. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.
meta:source_credibility_meta.source: Wilson & Sherrell (1993, Journal of the Academy of Marketing Science)

meta:sponsorship_disclosure_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Citation recognised; disclosure is recalled to lower attitudes only slightly. Magnitude not judgeable. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.
meta:sponsorship_disclosure_meta.source: Eisend, van Reijmersdal, Boerman & Tarrahi (2020, Journal of the Academy of Marketing Science)

meta:social_exclusion_ostracism_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Rejection and ostracism meta-analyses recalled; the largest reported effects (need satisfaction) are well above the stored -0.45, which is deliberately conservative and not a published figure. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.
meta:social_exclusion_ostracism_meta.source: Gerber & Wheeler (2009, Perspectives on Psychological Science); Hartgerink et al. (2015, PLOS ONE)

meta:expressive_writing_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Frattaroli (2006) recalled as k=146 with a pooled r of about .075 (d about 0.15). No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.

meta:gratitude_intervention_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Citation recognised; k and a modest effect recalled with moderate confidence, exact d not. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.
meta:gratitude_intervention_meta.source: Davis et al. (2016, Journal of Counseling Psychology)

meta:positive_psychology_intervention_me.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Citation recognised (k about 39; subjective well-being about 0.3, depression about 0.2); stored 0.25 is a conservative blend, not a published figure. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.
meta:positive_psychology_intervention_me.source: Bolier et al. (2013, BMC Public Health)

meta:cognitive_reappraisal_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Citation recognised; a small-to-medium reappraisal effect is recalled but the number is not. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.

meta:active_learning_stem_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Freeman et al. (2014) recalled as 225 studies and about 0.47 SD on exams. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.

meta:feedback_intervention_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Kluger & DeNisi (1996) recalled as a mean effect of about 0.41 SD with roughly one third of interventions harmful. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.

meta:tailored_health_messages_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Noar, Benac & Harris (2007) recalled as k=57 with a pooled r of about .074 (d about 0.15). No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.

meta:graphic_warning_labels_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Citation recognised; effects differ by outcome (larger on fear and attention than on intentions) and a single blended figure is not recalled. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.

meta:illusory_truth_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Dechene et al. (2010) recalled as 51 studies and d of about 0.39. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.
meta:illusory_truth_meta.source: Dechene, Stahl, Hansen & Wanke (2010, Personality and Social Psychology Review)

meta:gamification_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Gamification meta-analyses recalled as positive and small-to-medium with quality moderators; the stored 0.30 is conservative and not a published figure. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.
meta:gamification_meta.source: Sailer & Homner (2020, Educational Psychology Review); Bai, Hew & Huang (2020)

meta:imagined_contact_meta.note: New entry (v1.3.0.5), written from recall: Citation recognised; a small-to-moderate attitude effect with k about 71 is recalled, the d is not. No primary source was read; k and N are recorded only where recalled and tau / I-squared are not recorded.
meta:imagined_contact_meta.source: Miles & Crisp (2014, Group Processes & Intergroup Relations)
